    // The 3D affine matrix widened to homogeneous form (fourth column 0,0,0,1).
    Matrix4x4(a: AffineTransform3D): Matrix4x4 {
        var m = a.Matrix;
        return (Number4(m.Row1.X, m.Row1.Y, m.Row1.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(m.Row2.X, m.Row2.Y, m.Row2.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(m.Row3.X, m.Row3.Y, m.Row3.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(m.Row4.X, m.Row4.Y, m.Row4.Z, 1.0));
    }
```

    // The homogeneous matrix mapping frame-local coordinates to world
    // coordinates.
    Matrix4x4(f: Frame3D): Matrix4x4 {
        var x = f.XAxis.Vector;
        var y = f.YAxis.Vector;
        var z = f.ZAxis.Vector;
        var o = f.Origin;
        return (Number4(x.X, x.Y, x.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(y.X, y.Y, y.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(z.X, z.Y, z.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(o.X, o.Y, o.Z, 1.0));
    }
```

    // The homogeneous matrix of the pose (rotation, then translation).
    Matrix4x4(pose: Pose3D): Matrix4x4
        => pose.Orientation.Matrix4x4 * Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(pose.Position.PositionVector);

    // The homogeneous matrix of the transform: S * R * T in row-vector order.
    Matrix4x4(t: TrsTransform3D): Matrix4x4
        => Matrix4x4.CreateScale(t.Scale) * t.Rotation.Matrix4x4
            * Matrix4x4.CreateTranslation(t.Translation);
